title: Ex Vivo Culture of Neonate Mouse Ovaries for Follicle Activation Study
author: Madsen, Birkebæk, et al.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Thaw FBS at 4 °C, mix gently, aliquot into sterile tubes and store at –20 °C (6–12 mo). Aliquot ITS into sterile tubes and store at 4 °C (1 mo). Aliquot penicillin‑streptomycin (P/S) into sterile tubes and store at –20 °C (1 yr). Reconstitute FSH powder with 750 µL solvent to obtain 100 mIU/µL, aliquot and store at –20 °C (6 mo). Weigh 0.1 g sodium selenite, dissolve in 10 mL ddH₂O, dilute 1:1000 to 10 ng/mL, filter through 0.2 µm, aliquot and store at –20 °C (1 yr).

steps.title: Make organ‑harvest medium
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL FBS to 2250 µL α‑MEM, mix, then pre‑equilibrate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ with the cap loosely attached for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Make fine‑dissection medium
steps.instruction: Combine 4445 µL α‑MEM, 500 µL FBS, 50 µL ITS and 5 µL FSH; mix thoroughly, transfer to an embryo dish and pre‑equilibrate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Make ex‑vivo culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix 4390 µL α‑MEM, 500 µL FBS, 50 µL ITS, 50 µL P/S, 5 µL FSH and 5 µL sodium selenite; mix thoroughly, place in 15 mL tubes with caps loosely attached and pre‑equilibrate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for ≥30 min. Prepare fresh before each medium exchange.

steps.title: Harvest ovaries from mice
steps.instruction: Place pre‑warmed organ‑harvest medium in an embryo dish on a 37 °C heated stage. Euthanize 7–8‑day‑old female mice by decapitation, position supine, clean abdomen with 70 % ethanol, separate skin and peritoneum with opposing lateral tension, locate ovaries adjacent to kidneys and uterine horns, carefully release each ovary keeping it intact, and immediately transfer ovaries to the pre‑warmed organ‑harvest medium (37 °C).

steps.title: Fine‑dissect ovaries
steps.instruction: Transfer ovaries to the warm fine‑dissection medium using forceps, handle gently to avoid compression, then under a stereomicroscope use fine needles to tease away surrounding connective tissue and release the ovary from the bursa: stabilize the ovary with one needle while the other separates attachments, avoiding puncture or compression, until the capsule is intact and the ovary is free.

steps.title: Incubate dissected ovaries
steps.instruction: Place the isolated ovaries in the fine‑dissection medium and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ while preparing the next steps.

steps.title: Section paraffin‑embedded ovaries
steps.instruction: Fill a water bath with distilled water and set to 37 °C. Label glass slides with group name, ovary number and date. Mount the paraffin block in a microtome, install a new blade, set thickness to 5 µm, adjust the knife close to the block without contact, trim until tissue appears, then reduce cutting speed to obtain continuous ribbons. Collect all ribbons, maintaining serial order; prepare ribbons of 8–9 sections, leaving the final section attached to the blade. Float ribbons on the 37 °C water bath to expand, then transfer sections to the pre‑labeled slides with a fine needle, preserving orientation. Continue until the whole ovary is processed (≈40–60 sections after 96 h culture).

steps.title: Perform H&E staining
steps.instruction: Place slides in a rack and incubate in a pre‑warmed oven at 60 °C to melt paraffin. Deparaffinize by immersing in two xylene baths, 15 min each. Rehydrate through graded ethanol: 100 % ethanol three times (2 min each), 96 % ethanol 2 min, 70 % ethanol 2 min. Rinse in distilled water 2 min. Stain with hematoxylin (determine optimal time; start ~10 s for fresh hematoxylin) then rinse under running tap water 5 min. Transfer to eosin (determine optimal time). Dehydrate: 96 % ethanol (20 up‑and‑down motions), 96 % ethanol 2 min, 100 % ethanol twice (2 min each), then xylene 2 min followed by a 30 min xylene bath. Follow the detailed Table 2 sequence (Xylene 1 15 min, Xylene 2 15 min, Ethanol 100 % 1 2 min, Ethanol 100 % 2 2 min, Ethanol 100 % 3 2 min, Ethanol 96 % 2 min, Ethanol 70 % 2 min, Distilled water 2 min, Hematoxylin variable, Tap water 5 min, Eosin variable, Ethanol 96 % 2 min (agitate 20×), Ethanol 96 % 2 min, Ethanol 100 % 12 min, Ethanol 100 % 22 min, Xylene 12 min, Xylene 30 min). Mount slides with three drops of mounting medium, add a cover glass, and let dry ≥24 h before handling.

steps.title: Analyze follicle morphology
steps.instruction: Select every 5th ovarian section. Count only follicles with a clearly visible oocyte nucleus to avoid double counting. Classify each counted follicle: primordial – oocyte surrounded by a single layer of flattened pre‑granulosa cells; primary (including transitional) – oocyte with one layer of cuboidal granulosa cells or a mix of flattened and cuboidal cells; secondary – oocyte with ≥2 layers of cuboidal granulosa cells; degenerated – shrunken ooplasm, pyknotic nucleus or disorganized granulosa cells. Express counts as total follicles per ovary (multiply by the interval between sections) or as percentage of total follicles.
